items.source: Return the HTTP request methods of this RequestMappingInfo; or instance with 0 request methods (never null).
items.translation: 返回此RequestMappingInfo的 HTTP 请求方法；或实例，其具有 0 个请求方法（永远不为null）。

items.source:
Returns a new instance with a union of the HTTP request methods
from "this" and the "other" instance.
items.translation: 返回一个包含“this”和“other”实例的 HTTP 请求方法的并集的新实例。

items.source: A logical disjunction (' || ') request condition that matches a request against a set of RequestMethods.
items.translation: 一个逻辑或（' || '）请求条件，用于将请求与一组RequestMethods进行匹配。

items.source: Servlet-based infrastructure for handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method package.

items.translation: 用于根据条件匹配传入请求的通用 MVC 逻辑。

items.source:
Check if any of the HTTP request methods match the given request and
return an instance that contains the matching HTTP request method only.
items.translation: 检查是否有任何 HTTP 请求方法与给定请求匹配，并返回一个仅包含匹配 HTTP 请求方法的实例。

items.source:
Returns:

0 if the two conditions contain the same number of HTTP request methods
Less than 0 if "this" instance has an HTTP request method but "other" doesn't
Greater than 0 "other" has an HTTP request method but "this" doesn't
